name: cc-board
description: Per-session checklist (todos + manual steps you tick off) and a live board of every Claude Code session on this machine.

haikuSummary.title: Haiku summary
haikuSummary.description: When the todo list is empty, ask Haiku for a one-sentence summary of what the session is doing (at most once per five minutes).

boardGist.title: Board gist id
boardGist.description: Id of a secret GitHub gist that holds one file per session, so every machine sees one board. Empty keeps the board local. Also read from CC_BOARD_GIST.

boardToken.title: Board gist token
boardToken.description: A GitHub token with the gist scope, used only to read and write that gist. Also read from CC_BOARD_TOKEN.
